CREATE VIEW [dbo].[SalesView]
AS
SELECT     dbo.InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceNo, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceType, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID, dbo.Items.ItemName, dbo.Category.CategoryName, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.SLNo, 
                      dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Qty, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Mrp, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.SaleRate, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Amount, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.ItemName AS IName, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.SrNo, 
                      dbo.InvoiceDetails1.FYear, dbo.Category.MName, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode, dbo.Firms.FirmName, dbo.Firms.FirmAddress, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.GSTID, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.GST, 
                      dbo.InvoiceDetails1.GSTAmt, dbo.Firms.Tin, dbo.Stock.HSNCode, dbo.FixedItems.HSNCode AS FIxHSN, dbo.FixedItems.FMarathiName, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Pcs, dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Mtrs, 
                      dbo.SizeMF.SizeName, dbo.Stock.Prefix, dbo.Stock.Info, dbo.Category.HSNCode AS CatHSN, dbo.Brand.BrandName, dbo.Brand.ShortName AS BrandShortName, 
                      dbo.Category.CategoryName AS CatShortName, dbo.SchoolMF.SchoolName, dbo.SchoolMF.ShortName AS SchShortName, dbo.Firms.FirmAddress1, dbo.Firms.FirmAddress2, 
                      dbo.Firms.ShortName AS FirmShortName
FROM         dbo.InvoiceDetails1 LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.SchoolMF ON dbo.InvoiceDetails1.SchoolID = dbo.SchoolMF.SchoolID LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Stock ON dbo.InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID = dbo.Stock.BarCodeID LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Items ON dbo.Stock.ItemCode = dbo.Items.ItemCode LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Category ON dbo.Stock.CategoryCode = dbo.Category.CategoryCode LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Firms ON dbo.InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode = dbo.Firms.FirmCode LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.FixedItems ON dbo.InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID = dbo.FixedItems.FItemcode LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.SizeMF ON dbo.Stock.SizeID = dbo.SizeMF.SizeID LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.Brand ON dbo.Stock.BrandCode = dbo.Brand.BrandCode
WHERE     (dbo.InvoiceDetails1.Deleted = 0)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetCashInvoiceNo] (@pFirmCode int, @pFY varchar(10), @pBillAmt Numeric(18,2), @dbNumber Numeric(18,0) OUTPUT)
AS
--DECLARE @dbFY varchar(10)
DECLARE @invNumber Numeric(18,0)
DECLARE @SQL nvarchar(500)
DECLARE @ParamDef nvarchar(500)
DECLARE @pNumber varchar(25)

BEGIN TRANSACTION
	Select @dbNumber=InvoiceNo_0 From Firms
			WITH (UPDLOCK)
			WHERE FirmCode=@pFirmCode
	
	SELECT @dbNumber=@dbNumber+1	

	SELECT @invNumber=Invoice.InvoiceNo From 
		Invoice WHERE	InvoiceNo = @dbNumber AND 
						InvoiceType = 0 AND
						FirmCode = @pFirmCode AND
						FYear = @pFY
	IF @invNumber>0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @invNumber=Max(Invoice.InvoiceNo) From 
				Invoice WHERE	InvoiceType = 0 AND
								FirmCode = @pFirmCode AND
								FYear = @pFY
		Select @dbNumber = @invNumber + 1
	END
	UPDATE Firms SET [InvoiceNo_0]=@dbNumber, [LastBillAmt_0]=@pBillAmt WHERE FirmCode=@pFirmCode

	
COMMIT TRANSACTION
RETURN @dbNumber

stored_module_definitions.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[HSNInvoice] (@InvoiceNo int, @InvoiceType int, @FirmCode int, @FYear varchar(10), @MaxFixedItem int)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
	Select HSN, ItemName, Sum(NetQty) as Qty, GST, Sum(TaxableAmt) as Amount, Sum(GSTAmt) as GSTAmt
	From
		(
			SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL([Stock].[HSNCode],0)>0 THEN [Stock].[HSNCode] ELSE [Category].[HSNCode] END AS HSN,
			Category.CategoryName as ItemName, Sum(ID.Qty) AS NetQty, ID.GST, Sum(ID.Amount) AS TaxableAmt, Sum(ID.GSTAmt) AS GSTAmt		
			FROM (InvoiceDetails ID LEFT JOIN Stock ON ID.BarCodeID = Stock.BarCodeID) LEFT JOIN Category On Stock.CategoryCode=Category.CategoryCode
			WHERE id.BarCodeID>@MaxFixedItem AND ID.FirmCode=@FirmCode AND ID.FYear=@FYear AND ID.InvoiceType=@InvoiceType AND ID.InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
			GROUP BY CASE WHEN ISNULL([Stock].[HSNCode],0)>0 THEN [Stock].[HSNCode] ELSE [Category].[HSNCode] END, Category.CategoryName, ID.GST	
			
			UNION ALL

			SELECT ISNULL(FixedItems.HSNCode,0) as HSN, FixedItems.FItemname as ItemName, 
				Sum(ID.Qty) AS NetQty,  ID.GST, Sum(ID.Amount) AS TaxableAmt, Sum(ID.GSTAmt) AS GSTAmt
			FROM InvoiceDetails ID LEFT JOIN FixedItems ON ID.BarCodeID = FixedItems.FItemcode
			WHERE id.BarCodeID<=@MaxFixedItem AND ID.FirmCode=@FirmCode AND ID.FYear=@FYear AND ID.InvoiceType=@InvoiceType AND ID.InvoiceNo = @InvoiceNo 
			GROUP BY FixedItems.HSNCode, FixedItems.FItemname, ID.GST
		) Tab
	Group By HSN, ItemName, GST
)

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[QSalesReturn] (@ReturnNo int)
AS
SELECT	SalesReturnDetails.ReturnNo, SalesReturn.ReturnDate, SalesReturn.InvoiceType,
		SalesReturnDetails.BarcodeID, SalesReturnDetails.SLNo, SalesReturn.CustName, SizeMF.SizeName,
		Items.ItemName, Brand.BrandName, Category.CategoryName, FixedItems.FItemname, Stock.HSNCode, Category.HSNCode as CatHSN,
		SalesReturnDetails.Qty, SalesReturnDetails.SaleRate, SalesReturnDetails.Amount, 
		SalesReturnDetails.GST, SalesReturnDetails.GSTAmt, SalesReturn.Amount AS TotalAmt, 
		SalesReturnDetails.InvoiceNo, SalesReturn.Narration, SalesReturn.CshChq, SalesReturn.isRG,
		Firms.FirmName, Firms.FirmAddress, Firms.Tin, 
		Customer.CustName AS CreditCustName, Customer.Address AS CreditAddress, Customer.City, 
		Customer.GSTIN, Customer.StateID, StateMF.StateName
FROM (((((((((SalesReturnDetails LEFT JOIN Stock ON SalesReturnDetails.BarcodeID = Stock.BarCodeID) LEFT JOIN 
										Items ON Stock.ItemCode = Items.ItemCode) LEFT JOIN 
									 	Category ON Stock.CategoryCode = Category.CategoryCode) LEFT JOIN 
										Brand ON Stock.BrandCode = Brand.BrandCode) LEFT JOIN 
										SizeMF ON Stock.SizeID = SizeMF.SizeID) 
			LEFT JOIN FixedItems ON SalesReturnDetails.BarcodeID = FixedItems.FItemcode)
			INNER JOIN SalesReturn ON SalesReturnDetails.ReturnNo = SalesReturn.ReturnNo)
			LEFT JOIN Firms ON SalesReturn.FirmCode = Firms.FirmCode)
			LEFT JOIN Customer ON SalesReturn.Cust_ID = Customer.Cust_ID) 
			LEFT JOIN StateMF ON Customer.StateID = StateMF.StateID
WHERE SalesReturnDetails.ReturnNo=@ReturnNo;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SalesBill] (@InvoiceNo int, @InvoiceType Int, @FYear varchar(50), @FirmCode int)
AS

SELECT Sales.InvoiceNo, Sales.InvoiceType, Sales.FYear, Invoice1.InvoiceDate, Sales.BarCodeID, 
	   Sales.Prefix, Sales.Info, Sales.CategoryName, Sales.BrandName, Sales.MName, Sales.ItemName, 
	   Sales.SizeName, Sales.IName, Sales.SLNo, Sales.CatHSN, Sales.HSNCode, Sales.FIxHSN, 
	   Sales.FMarathiName, Sales.Pcs, Sales.Mtrs, Sales.Qty, Sales.Mrp, Sales.SaleRate, 
	   Sales.Amount, Sales.GSTID, Sales.GST, Sales.GSTAmt, Invoice1.GSTAmt AS NetGST, 
	   Invoice1.TotalAmt, Invoice1.DiscAmt, Invoice1.AdvAmt, Invoice1.ExchangeAmt, 
	   Invoice1.NetAmt, Invoice1.RGVchNo, Invoice1.RGAmount, Invoice1.CardPayCharges, 
	   Invoice1.RoundAmt, Invoice1.CustomerName, Invoice1.CardPay, Invoice1.CashPay, Invoice1.PackSlip, CounterMF.SectionName,Sales.PQty, Sales.PackNo,
	   Invoice1.UserID, Invoice1.Time, Sales.FirmCode, Sales.FirmName, Sales.FirmAddress, Sales.Tin, Sales.Status, Sales.FirmAddress1, Sales.FirmAddress2,
	   Sales.SrNo, Invoice1.Narration, Invoice1.CoupenDisc, Invoice1.TaxAdditional, Token.SrNo as TSrNo,
	   CashCustomer.CustName, CashCustomer.Mobile, City.CityName AS CashCustCity, TalukaMF.AreaName as TalukaName, Dist.CityName as DistName,
	   AreaMF.AreaName AS CashCustAreaName, CashCustomer.GSTIN AS CashCustGSTIN, Invoice1.QRCodeImg,
	   Customer.CustName AS CreditCustName, Customer.GSTIN AS CreditCustGSTIN, Invoice1.DaySrNo,
	   Customer.Address As CreditCustAddress, Customer.City As CreditCustCity, Customer.StateID, StateMF.StateName, Customer.Mobile as CreditMobile
FROM (((((((((Sales(@InvoiceNo, @InvoiceType, @FYear, @FirmCode) INNER JOIN Invoice1 ON 
									   Sales.FYear = Invoice1.FYear AND 
									   Sales.InvoiceNo = Invoice1.InvoiceNo AND 
									   Sales.InvoiceType = Invoice1.InvoiceType AND 
									   Sales.FirmCode = Invoice1.FirmCode) 
				LEFT JOIN CashCustomer ON Invoice1.CashCust_ID = CashCustomer.Cust_ID) 
				LEFT JOIN Customer ON Invoice1.Cust_ID = Customer.Cust_ID) 
				LEFT JOIN CounterMF On Invoice1.SectionID=CounterMF.SectionID)
				LEFT JOIN Token On Invoice1.TokenID=Token.TokenID)
				LEFT JOIN StateMF ON Customer.StateID = StateMF.StateID) 
				LEFT JOIN AreaMF ON CashCustomer.AreaID = AreaMF.AreaID) 
				LEFT JOIN AreaMF AS TalukaMF ON AreaMF.ParentAreaID = TalukaMF.AreaID) 
				LEFT JOIN City As Dist ON TalukaMF.CityID = Dist.CityCode) 
				LEFT JOIN City ON AreaMF.CityID = City.CityCode

WHERE Sales.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo AND 
	  Sales.InvoiceType=@InvoiceType AND 
	  Sales.FYear=@FYear AND 
	  Sales.FirmCode=@FirmCode AND 
	  Invoice1.Deleted=0
ORDER BY Sales.SrNo;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SalesBillMF] (@InvoiceNo int, @InvoiceType Int, @FYear varchar(50), @FirmCode int)
AS

SELECT SalesMF.InvoiceNo, SalesMF.InvoiceType, SalesMF.FYear, Invoice1.InvoiceDate, SalesMF.BarCodeID, 
		SalesMF.Prefix, SalesMF.Info, SalesMF.CategoryName, SalesMF.BrandName, SalesMF.MName, SalesMF.ItemName, 
		SalesMF.SizeName, SalesMF.IName, SalesMF.SLNo, SalesMF.CatHSN, SalesMF.HSNCode, SalesMF.FIxHSN, 
		SalesMF.FMarathiName, SalesMF.Pcs, SalesMF.Mtrs, SalesMF.Qty, SalesMF.Mrp, SalesMF.SaleRate, 
		SalesMF.Amount, SalesMF.GSTID, SalesMF.GST, SalesMF.GSTAmt, Invoice1.GSTAmt AS NetGST, 
		Invoice1.TotalAmt, Invoice1.DiscAmt, Invoice1.AdvAmt, Invoice1.ExchangeAmt, 
		Invoice1.NetAmt, Invoice1.RGVchNo, Invoice1.RGAmount, Invoice1.CardPayCharges, Invoice1.QRCodeImg,
		Invoice1.RoundAmt, Invoice1.CustomerName, Invoice1.CardPay, Invoice1.CashPay, Invoice1.PackSlip, SectionMF.SectionName,
		Invoice1.UserID, Invoice1.Time, SalesMF.FCatID, SalesMF.FirmCode, SalesMF.FirmName, SalesMF.FirmAddress, SalesMF.Tin, SalesMF.[Status], SalesMF.FirmShortName, SalesMF.BillPrefix,
		SalesMF.SrNo, Invoice1.Narration, Invoice1.CoupenDisc, Invoice1.TaxAdditional, 
		CashCustomer.CustName, CashCustomer.Mobile, City.CityName AS CashCustCity, TalukaMF.AreaName as TalukaName, Dist.CityName as DistName,
		AreaMF.AreaName AS CashCustAreaName, CashCustomer.GSTIN AS CashCustGSTIN, 
		Customer.CustName AS CreditCustName, Customer.GSTIN AS CreditCustGSTIN, 
		Customer.Address As CreditCustAddress, Customer.City As CreditCustCity, Customer.StateID, StateMF.StateName,
   		Invoice1.M1, Invoice1.M2, Invoice1.M3, Invoice1.M4, 
   		Invoice1.Amt1, Invoice1.Amt2, Invoice1.Amt3, Invoice1.Amt4, 
   		Invoice1.Tax1, Invoice1.Tax2, Invoice1.Tax3, Invoice1.Tax4, 
   		Invoice1.IDisc1, Invoice1.IDisc2, Invoice1.IDisc3, Invoice1.IDisc4, 
   		Invoice1.Exch1, Invoice1.Exch2, Invoice1.Exch3, Invoice1.Exch4, 
   		Invoice1.Card1, Invoice1.Card2, Invoice1.Card3, Invoice1.Card4

FROM ((((((((SalesMF(@InvoiceNo, @InvoiceType, @FYear, @FirmCode) INNER JOIN Invoice1 ON 
									   SalesMF.FYear = Invoice1.FYear AND 
									   SalesMF.InvoiceNo = Invoice1.InvoiceNo AND 
									   SalesMF.InvoiceType = Invoice1.InvoiceType AND 
									   SalesMF.FirmCode = Invoice1.FirmCode) 
				LEFT JOIN CashCustomer ON Invoice1.CashCust_ID = CashCustomer.Cust_ID) 
				LEFT JOIN Customer ON Invoice1.Cust_ID = Customer.Cust_ID) 
				LEFT JOIN SectionMF On Invoice1.SectionID=SectionMF.SectionID)
				LEFT JOIN StateMF ON Customer.StateID = StateMF.StateID) 
				LEFT JOIN AreaMF ON CashCustomer.AreaID = AreaMF.AreaID) 
				LEFT JOIN AreaMF AS TalukaMF ON AreaMF.ParentAreaID = TalukaMF.AreaID) 
				LEFT JOIN City As Dist ON TalukaMF.CityID = Dist.CityCode) 
				LEFT JOIN City ON AreaMF.CityID = City.CityCode

WHERE SalesMF.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo AND 
	  SalesMF.InvoiceType=@InvoiceType AND 
	  SalesMF.FYear=@FYear AND 
	  SalesMF.FirmCode=@FirmCode AND 
	  Invoice1.Deleted=0
ORDER BY SalesMF.SrNo;

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Sales] (@InvoiceNo Bigint, @InvoiceType Int, @FYear nvarchar(50), @FirmCode int)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
	SELECT     InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceNo, InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceType, InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID, Items.ItemName, Category.CategoryName, InvoiceDetails1.SLNo, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.Qty, InvoiceDetails1.Mrp, InvoiceDetails1.SaleRate, InvoiceDetails1.Amount, InvoiceDetails1.ItemName AS IName, InvoiceDetails1.SrNo, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.FYear, Category.MName, InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode, Firms.FirmName, Firms.FirmAddress, InvoiceDetails1.GSTID, InvoiceDetails1.GST, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.GSTAmt, Firms.Tin, Stock.HSNCode, FixedItems.HSNCode AS FIxHSN, FixedItems.FMarathiName, InvoiceDetails1.Pcs, InvoiceDetails1.Mtrs, 
						  SizeMF.SizeName, Stock.Prefix, Stock.Info, Category.HSNCode AS CatHSN, Brand.BrandName, Brand.ShortName AS BrandShortName, 
						  Category.CategoryName AS CatShortName, SchoolMF.SchoolName, SchoolMF.ShortName AS SchShortName, Firms.FirmAddress1, Firms.FirmAddress2, 
						  Firms.ShortName AS FirmShortName, Firms.Status, InvoiceDetails1.PackNo, InvoiceDetails1.PQty
	FROM   (((((((InvoiceDetails1 LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  SchoolMF ON InvoiceDetails1.SchoolID = SchoolMF.SchoolID) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Stock ON InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID = Stock.BarCodeID) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Items ON Stock.ItemCode = Items.ItemCode) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Category ON Stock.CategoryCode = Category.CategoryCode) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Firms ON InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode = Firms.FirmCode) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  FixedItems ON InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID = FixedItems.FItemcode) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  SizeMF ON Stock.SizeID = SizeMF.SizeID) LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  Brand ON Stock.BrandCode = Brand.BrandCode
						  --) LEFT OUTER JOIN PackDetails ON  InvoiceDetails1.PackNo=PackDetails.PackNo AND InvoiceDetails1.PackDate=PackDetails.PackDate AND InvoiceDetails1.PSrNo=PackDetails.SrNo						  
	WHERE InvoiceDetails1.Deleted = 0 AND 
		  InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceNo=@InvoiceNo AND 
		  InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceType=@InvoiceType AND 
		  InvoiceDetails1.FYear=@FYear AND 
		  InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode=@FirmCode 
)

RETURN
(
	SELECT     InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceNo, InvoiceDetails1.InvoiceType, InvoiceDetails1.BarCodeID, Items.ItemName, Category.CategoryName, InvoiceDetails1.SLNo, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.Qty, InvoiceDetails1.Mrp, InvoiceDetails1.SaleRate, InvoiceDetails1.Amount, InvoiceDetails1.ItemName AS IName, InvoiceDetails1.SrNo, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.FYear, Category.MName, InvoiceDetails1.FirmCode, Firms.FirmName, Firms.FirmAddress, InvoiceDetails1.GSTID, InvoiceDetails1.GST, 
						  InvoiceDetails1.GSTAmt, Firms.Tin, Stock.HSNCode, FixedItems.HSNCode AS FIxHSN, FixedItems.FMarathiName, InvoiceDetails1.Pcs, InvoiceDetails1.Mtrs, 
						  SizeMF.SizeName, Stock.Prefix, Stock.Info, Category.HSNCode AS CatHSN, Brand.BrandName, Brand.ShortName AS BrandShortName,

						  InvoiceDetails1.FCatID, Firms.FirmAddress1, Firms.FirmAddress2, Firms.ShortName AS FirmShortName, Firms.[Status], Firms.BillPrefix
	FROM   (((((((InvoiceDetails1 LEFT OUTER JOIN
						  SchoolMF ON InvoiceDetails1.SchoolID = SchoolMF.SchoolID) LEFT OUTER JOIN
